selection.rationale: Best fit for the one reusable Agent Skills slot: concrete guidance for encoding repeatable DevOps investigation procedures into focused, composable skills with explicit activation criteria.
Strong implementation-level pattern for persistent multi-agent systems: shared session identity, durable volumes, GPU access, multi-day execution, and independently deployable agents.
Material model shift for long-horizon professional work across coding, legal, finance, research, and cyber; strong relevance with phased availability caveats preserved.
Directly addresses a recurring enterprise adoption problem: converting fragmented context into provenance-aware, human-validated knowledge that people and agents can reuse.
Clear nontechnical model for always-on agents with read-only background research, visible activity, explicit permissions, and approval boundaries for consequential actions.
Practical business-agent pattern connecting governed data to automations without copying it, while preserving existing access, policy, lineage, and auditability controls.

excluded_reviewed.reason: Useful hands-on training signal, but less directly valuable than the selected reusable-skill and persistent-runtime engineering patterns.
Strong shared-context architecture, but it is the sole extended-168-hour item and the two selected applied stories are both fresher and more distinct for today's edition.
Useful internal-audit accelerator pattern, but the selected Dots and Snowflake/UiPath items cover broader nontechnical agent use and governance with less overlap.

invariant: One semantic selection pass; exact 2 / 2 / 2 allocation; exactly one Agent Skills story; all six selected candidates are contained in the frozen evidence packet.
